description.other_details: Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) Supplement 122: Specimen Module and Revised Pathology SOP Classes DICOM Standards Committee, Working Groups 26, Pathology.

details.use: Use where highly precise localisation information is required, using co-ordinates.
details.misuse: The parent OBSERVATION.anatomical_location archetype is generally sufficient for simple gross/surface anatomical location.

items.items: DICOM based coordinate based system for accurate object localisation.
